description: This file contains functions for Windows-specific filesystem monitoring utilities, including checking remote protocol info and determining if a filesystem is remote.

methods.name: check_remote_protocol
methods.description: Checks remote protocol information for a given wide-character path, returning -1 on failure.

methods.name: fsmonitor__get_fs_info
methods.description: Determines if the filesystem at the given path is remote and retrieves protocol info if applicable.

methods.name: fsmonitor__is_fs_remote
methods.description: Returns whether the filesystem at the given path is remote.

methods.name: fsmonitor__get_alias
methods.description: Stub function for getting alias info, currently no operation.

methods.name: fsmonitor__resolve_alias
methods.description: Stub function for resolving aliases, currently returns NULL.
